definitions.full: H1621. gargeroth גַּרְגְּרוֺת noun feminine plural neck (on formation compare Ba NB 204 ) — גַּרְגְּרֹתֶ֑יךָ Prov 1:9 ; 3:22 , גַּרְגְרוֺתֶ֑ךָ 3:3 , גַּרְגְּרֹתֶ֑ךָ 6:21 — always in figure, instruction of parents an ornament, a chain upon neck 1:9 , bind them upon thy neck 6:21 ; so of mercy & truth 3:3 , compare 3:22 .
